easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
